Commentary.Commentary: We are back for India's reply. Nur Dania Syuhada leads her troops out to the centre. It will be Trisha Gongadi and Kamalini G to open the innings for India. Suabika has the new ball in hand and is raring to go.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now, the Indian side are set for what should be a cakewalk of a chase. You know what they say, cricket’s a funny game. But surely, the hosts can't snatch victory from the jaws of defeat. If they can, it would be worth watching! Stay tuned, as we will be back with India's reply in a short while...

Vaishnavi Sharma is in for a chat. says that this was a dream debut to get a hat-trick and five-wicket haul. Mentions that her journey has had its ups and downs. Tells that she looks up to Radha Yadav and Ravindra Jadeja. Adds that she had visualised getting wickets last night.

It was a day when none of the Malaysia Women Under-19 batters managed to score in double digits. Yes, none of their batters scored in double digits! None of their batters went over the score of 5 runs as well! Let’s just say it was a day for them to forget against the mighty Indian side.

What a sensational display of bowling we've witnessed from the India Women Under-19 side! They went full throttle against the hosts, Malaysia Women Under-19, leaving their batters wondering. They kept on picking wickets at regular intervals. It was Joshitha V J who led the initial assault. Vaishnavi Sharma, the debutant, later took the job in her hands and picked up a fifer. She picked up a hat-trick as well. The rest of the bowlers then supported in the wicket-taking job as they ultimately bundled out the hosts for a mere 31 runs!

Welcome to Match 16 of the ICC Women's Under-19 T20 World Cup 2025, where India Women Under-19 take on hosts Malaysia Women Under-19 at the Bayuemas Oval in Kuala Lumpur! The defending champions, India, are off to a flying start, having dominated their opening match against West Indies Women Under-19 with an all-round display of excellence.
... MATCH DAY ...

The ICC Women's Under-19 T20 World Cup 2025 is gathering momentum, and we turn our attention to Match 16, a Group A clash where India Women Under-19 take on the hosts, Malaysia Women Under-19, at the Bayuemas Oval in Kuala Lumpur. India, the defending champions, have already set the tournament ablaze with a dominant performance in their opener, demolishing West Indies Women Under-19. From the very first ball, India’s bowlers made their intentions clear. Joshitha V J and Shabnam used the new ball masterfully, while their potent spin attack wasted no time dismantling the opposition. Complemented by razor-sharp fielding, India’s all-round excellence made them look nearly invincible, as their batting lineup comfortably chased down the target despite looming weather concerns. Malaysia Women Under-19, on the other hand, had a mixed start to their campaign. While they showed admirable grit and promise with the ball and in the field, their batting lineup struggled and collapsed to record the lowest-ever total in Women’s Under-19 World Cup history. The bowlers, particularly the spinners, were impressive in finding breakthroughs, but they failed to tighten the screws and allowed partnerships to blossom. This is a key area Malaysia will need to address if they hope to compete against an Indian side that is in red-hot form. For the hosts, the challenge is immense, but so is the opportunity to make a statement. Putting their opening loss behind them, they will need to come out fresh, bring determination to the forefront, and focus on the little moments that could turn the tide. While India enters this game as overwhelming favourites, Malaysia’s resilience and the home crowd’s energy could make for an intriguing contest. Can Malaysia Women Under-19 rise to the occasion, or will India Women Under-19 march on with another commanding performance? We shall soon find out!
